seo.title: Consulting
seo.description: Consulting with Dr. Len Tau: a clear plan for your online reputation, reviews and marketing, and a team that runs it.

questions.title: Do you have a | marketing problem?
questions: Do you have a steady flow of new patients?
Are you using your online presence strategically?
Is your online reputation strong and working for you?
Are your reviews bringing patients to you?
Is your brand consistent on every social platform?

intro.title: Get clear on where you are | and where you need to go.
paragraphs: That is what consulting with me is for. We look at your whole online presence, then build a plan to create a steady flow of new patients.
Then we get your team on the same page, so the system runs every day without depending on you.

pricing.title: Choose how | we work together.
pricing.intro: Every package starts with a full look at your current marketing.
